task: Evolve the Starlight robot character system through a controlled Lyra direction pilot and reusable image-generation contracts
surface: Starlight Research Team character direction review; no production surface yet
audience: Frank as brand decision owner, followed by builders of governed multi-agent systems

direction.keep: The current dark Starlight porcelain-and-obsidian robot family, Lyra's segmented cranium and narrow faceplate, cinematic restraint, and premium material craft
direction.avoid: A fundamental rebrand, interchangeable cape-and-pedestal portraits, royal or divine symbolism, internal human-authority cues, fake interface text, and generic neon science fiction
direction.signature: Role-shaped morphology: several bounded research inputs become one tangible routed task packet under a separate human approval gate
direction.system: Three controlled hypotheses plus one corrective edit, all linked to the canonical card, source reference, immutable hash, inspection score, and human-gated selection receipt

asset_quality.why_premium: Owned identity continuity, controlled art direction, tactile role-specific instruments, high-fidelity materials, export inspection, immutable receipts, and explicit governance semantics
